name: Create Owner

attributes.name: FirstName
attributes.description: The first name of the owner. This value is required when CompanyName is not provided.

attributes.name: LastName
attributes.description: The last name of the owner. This value is required when CompanyName is not provided.

attributes.name: CompanyName
attributes.description: The company name associated with the owner. This value is required when FirstName or LastName is not provided.

attributes.name: Email
attributes.description: The primary email address of the owner

attributes.name: PhoneNumber
attributes.description: The owner's primary phone number

attributes.name: Address1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the owner

attributes.name: Address2
attributes.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the owner

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: The city where the owner is located

attributes.name: State
attributes.description: The state where the owner is located. This attribute must not be an unincorporated US territory, i.e., (AS, FM, MH, MP, or VI) for primary address when UseOnlinePayables and OwnerPaidByACH are both true. This value must be valid when UseOnlinePayables is true, OwnerPaidByACH and UseAlternatePayee are both false or not provided.

attributes.name: Zip
attributes.description: The zip code where the owner is located. Must be a string in 5-digit ZIP code format (e.g., 93013) or ZIP+4 format (e.g., 93013-0429). This attribute is required for primary address when UseOnlinePayables and OwnerPaidByACH are both true or when UseOnlinePayables is true, OwnerPaidByACH and UseAlternatePayee are both false or not provided.

attributes.name: CountryCode
attributes.description: The country code of the owner (e.g. US for United states). This attribute must be US for primary address when UseOnlinePayables and OwnerPaidByACH are both true or when UseOnlinePayables is true, OwnerPaidByACH and UseAlternatePayee are both false or not provided.

attributes.name: OwnerPaidByACH
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner is paid via ACH (Automated Clearing House) transfer

attributes.name: UseOnlinePayables
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner is paid via online payables

attributes.name: BankAccountRoutingNumber
attributes.description: The owner's bank account routing number. This attribute is required when UseOnlinePayables and OwnerPaidByACH are both true.

attributes.name: BankAccountNumber
attributes.description: The owner's bank account number. This attribute is required when UseOnlinePayables and OwnerPaidByACH are both true.

attributes.name: SavingsAccount
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner's bank account is a checking or savings account. If true, the owner is using a savings account; otherwise, the bank account in use is a checking account.

attributes.name: TaxpayerName
attributes.description: The name of the taxpayer associated with the owner's account

attributes.name: TaxpayerId
attributes.description: The tax identification number of the taxpayer associated with the owner's account

attributes.name: Send1099
attributes.description: Indicates whether a 1099 form is sent to the owner. Note: If Send1099 is set to false, only Send1099 will be considered in the request. The OwnerConsentedToReceiveElectronic1099 and Sending1099Preference values will not be processed.

attributes.name: OwnerConsentedToReceiveElectronic1099
attributes.description: Indicates whether the owner has consented to receive the 1099 tax form electronically. If true, the owner's Email must be provided in the request.

attributes.name: Sending1099Preference
attributes.description: Indicates the owner's 1099 sending preference. Valid values include "Paper", "Electronic" or "PaperAndElectronic".

attributes.name: EmailEcheckReceipt
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not to send a notification to the owner after an eCheck payment is made. It can only be set when Owner Vendor eCheck is enabled and the owner has a primary email address. Additionally, OwnerPaidByACH must be true. If Online Payables is enabled, UseOnlinePayables must also be true.

attributes.name: HoldPayments
attributes.description: When set to true, bills created for the owner through the Pay Owner or Owner Draw function will not be available in the Pay Bills flow.

attributes.name: Tags
attributes.description: User-defined tag(s) that categorize the owner

attributes.name: UseAlternatePayee
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the owner payments are submitted to an alternate person other than what is listed for Owner First, Last and/or Company Name

attributes.name: AlternatePayeeName
attributes.description: The name of the alternate payee. This attribute can be provided only when UseAlternatePayee is true.

attributes.name: AlternatePaymentAddress1
attributes.description: The street address of the Alternate Payee. This attribute must be provided when UseAlternatePayee is true.

attributes.name: AlternatePaymentAddress2
attributes.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the alternate payee. This attribute can be provided only when UseAlternatePayee is true.

attributes.name: AlternatePaymentCity
attributes.description: The city where the alternate payee is located. This attribute must be provided when UseAlternatePayee is true.

attributes.name: AlternatePaymentState
attributes.description: The state where the alternate payee is located. This attribute can be provided only when UseAlternatePayee is true. This attribute is required and must be valid when UseOnlinePayables is true and OwnerPaidByACH is false or not provided.

attributes.name: AlternatePaymentPostalCode
attributes.description: The zip code where the alternate payee is located. This attribute can be provided only when UseAlternatePayee is true. Must be a string in 5-digit ZIP code format (e.g., 93013) or ZIP+4 format (e.g., 93013-0429). This attribute is required when UseOnlinePayables is true and OwnerPaidByACH is false or not provided.

attributes.name: AlternatePaymentCountryCode
attributes.description: The country code of the alternate payee (e.g. US for United states). This attribute must be provided when UseAlternatePayee is true. This attribute must be US when UseOnlinePayables is true and OwnerPaidByACH is false or not provided.

attributes.name: Emails
attributes.description: The owner's emails. This attribute must not be provided together with Email.

attributes.name: EmailAddress
attributes.description: The owner's email address

attributes.name: IsPrimary
attributes.description: Indicates whether the email address provided is the owner's primary email address

attributes.name: PhoneNumbers
attributes.description: The owner's phone number(s). This attribute must not be provided together with PhoneNumber.

attributes.name: Number
attributes.description: The owner's phone number

attributes.name: AdditionalDetails
attributes.description: Additional detailed information pertaining to the phone number associated with the owner

attributes.name: IsPrimary
attributes.description: Indicates whether the phone number provided is the owner's main contact number

attributes.name: Label
attributes.description: The label of the phone number, e.g. 'Home'

attributes.name: Addresses
attributes.description: The owner's address(es). This attribute must not be provided together with Address1, Address2, City, State, Zip, or CountryCode. The primary address is required when UseOnlinePayables and OwnerPaidByACH are both true, or when UseOnlinePayables is true, OwnerPaidByACH and UseAlternatePayee are both false or not provided.

attributes.name: Address1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the owner

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: The city where the owner resides

attributes.name: CountryCode
attributes.description: The country code of the owner (e.g. "US" for United States). This attribute must be US for primary address when UseOnlinePayables and OwnerPaidByACH are both true or when UseOnlinePayables is true, OwnerPaidByACH and UseAlternatePayee are both false or not provided.

attributes.name: Address2
attributes.description: The secondary street address of the owner

attributes.name: State
attributes.description: The state where the owner resides. This attribute must not be an unincorporated US territory, i.e., (AS, FM, MH, MP, or VI) for primary address when UseOnlinePayables and OwnerPaidByACH are both true. This value must be valid when UseOnlinePayables is true, OwnerPaidByACH and UseAlternatePayee are both false or not provided.

attributes.name: PostalCode
attributes.description: The postal code where the owner resides. Must be a string in 5-digit ZIP code format (e.g., 93013) or ZIP+4 format (e.g., 93013-0429). This attribute is required for primary address when UseOnlinePayables and OwnerPaidByACH are both true or when UseOnlinePayables is true, OwnerPaidByACH and UseAlternatePayee are both false or not provided.

attributes.name: IsPrimary
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address provided is the owner's primary address

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the created owner
